name: tablet
description: THE APP ON THE TABLET (step 13, architect 2026-10-03): the tablet geometry ("geometry": "tablet", tools/palette/tablet.py: gui_scale 275, every length derived from the app's own constants) in the app's default look, the `warptempo` entry at its LIGHT level (device_config.h's defaults theme=warptempo, theme_level=light; architect 2026-10-03, the colour loop): the ground, label, relief quartet, emboss light copy, selected pair and field pair are tools/theme_catalog/levels.py's light row for the entry, the generated table's own (theme_table.h), and the card, when a mock switches it on, the ground under the label (the app's Info face); the app-specific roles by the role mapping (render.h's palette block: the ruler label the label, the ruler ticks Shadow with their etched Hilight, the flag outline DkShadow, the trim arrow the label, the checked face the ground under the Hilight dither); the program's own colours the device config's defaults (the waveform's ink, canvas and outline; the flag's face, selected face and label, the one selected label; the invalid face, its selected face and its label; the playhead's head and stem) and icons.cpp's fixed inks (kIconRecord, kIconPreviewOn, kIconAccent, kIconLiftCross). Every option is the app's (render.py TABLET_FIXED); the base of tools/theme_catalog/crops.py's themes and of every mock from step 13 on. Its colours equal themes/warptempo.json's, the default theme being that entry.
